name: Poonia Movers Centralized AI SEO & GEO Global Rule Registry

rules.name: AI Crawler Accessibility & Robots Directives
rules.description: Ensure public content is accessible to AI retrieval bots (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended) without unneeded blocking.
rules.condition: robots.txt must allow AI user-agents on public indexable pages and declare XML sitemap.
rules.recommendation_template: Explicitly allow AI search crawlers on public content while disallowing admin/private checkout paths.
rules.validation: Inspect robots.txt directives and response headers.

rules.name: XML Sitemap Discoverability & Canonical Uniformity
rules.description: All canonical URLs must be listed in sitemap.xml with 200 HTTP status and exact HTTPS scheme.
rules.condition: sitemap.xml exists, contains clean canonical URLs without parameter duplicates or redirect loops.
rules.recommendation_template: Maintain synchronized sitemap.xml with canonical tags on all pages.
rules.validation: Parse sitemap.xml and compare against page canonical tags.

rules.name: Root LLMs Knowledge Graph File (llms.txt)
rules.description: Provide a clean, structured llms.txt markdown file at domain root for direct LLM RAG ingestion.
rules.condition: llms.txt must exist at /llms.txt with verified NAP, rate benchmarks, and canonical URLs.
rules.recommendation_template: Deploy and maintain /llms.txt containing verified company operational data.
rules.validation: Verify existence, formatting, and non-hallucinated facts in llms.txt.

rules.name: Strict Single H1 and Logical Heading Hierarchy
rules.description: Every page must have exactly one semantic H1 describing the primary service and locality, followed by logically nested H2s and H3s.
rules.condition: count(h1) == 1 and no skipped heading levels (e.g. H1 -> H3).
rules.recommendation_template: Ensure exactly one H1 per page and nest sub-topics under H2 and H3 tags.
rules.validation: Extract all headings and verify hierarchy tree.

rules.name: Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) Direct Answer Block
rules.description: Important questions and service intros must provide the direct answer in the first sentence before explanations.
rules.condition: Hero and major sections must contain concise declarative answers.
rules.recommendation_template: State exact rate/time answers upfront in the first paragraph of each section.
rules.validation: Analyze text opening sentences for numerical and factual declarations.

rules.name: Atomic Content & Structural Chunking
rules.description: Content must be divided into discrete, easily retrievable atomic units using cards, lists, and tables rather than monolithic wall-of-text paragraphs.
rules.condition: No paragraphs exceeding 120 words without sub-breakdown; table or card representation for structured data.
rules.recommendation_template: Break dense content into modular cards, comparison tables, and bullet points.
rules.validation: Measure paragraph lengths and structured component ratio.

rules.name: Localized Geographic Node Coverage
rules.description: Pages must explicitly mention authentic local industrial zones, residential localities, PIN codes, and national highways.
rules.condition: Presence of specific local entities (e.g. VKI, Sitapura, Harmada, Bagru, NH-48, NH-52) rather than generic 'anywhere in city'.
rules.recommendation_template: Embed authentic industrial area names, highway numbers, and route distances.
rules.validation: Entity extraction on text content matching geographical database.

rules.name: Vehicle Specification & Payload Entity Depth
rules.description: Transport pages must specify exact truck models (Tata Ace, 14ft, 19ft, 32ft MXL), tonnages, container volume (Cu. Ft), and base rates.
rules.condition: Dedicated fleet cards or specs table present with payload in tons and rates.
rules.recommendation_template: Include dedicated vehicle payload and cubic capacity specifications on all freight pages.
rules.validation: Verify presence of commercial vehicle entity matrix.

rules.name: Live Dispatches & Structured Rate Matrices
rules.description: Pages must feature concrete numerical tables (e.g. recent dispatches feed, per-km rate matrices) that provide high-value citations for AI search engines.
rules.condition: At least one data table (.corridor-table or .data-table) with route distances, rates, or dispatch logs.
rules.recommendation_template: Provide live dispatches and route fare comparison tables on all commercial pages.
rules.validation: Check for table element with structured rows containing numbers and units.

rules.name: Carrier vs Broker Transparency Matrix
rules.description: Provide direct comparative table contrasting direct asset-backed carrier advantages against commission brokers and app aggregators.
rules.condition: Comparison matrix section present with clear differentiators (pricing, advance, fleet).
rules.recommendation_template: Maintain a comparison table highlighting 0% advance, fixed rates, and in-house fleet.
rules.validation: Verify presence of comparative matrix table.

rules.name: Verified Physical NAP & LocalBusiness Evidence
rules.description: Must provide consistent registered physical address, phone number, and Google Maps CID link matching official business registration.
rules.condition: Physical address in Harmada VKI, phone +91 85292 06001, and official Google Maps link present in footer and schema.
rules.recommendation_template: Ensure 100% exact NAP consistency across all page footers and structured data.
rules.validation: Match NAP in footer, header, and JSON-LD schema.

rules.name: Regulatory & Statutory Trust Badges (ISO / GST / E-Way)
rules.description: Display official compliance badges including ISO 9001:2015, 100% GST Invoice availability, E-Way Bill assistance, and Digital Bilty.
rules.condition: Badges or text blocks for ISO, GST, and 0% Advance present.
rules.recommendation_template: Display ISO 9001:2015 and GST compliance signals prominently in headers and footers.
rules.validation: Scan DOM for regulatory compliance mentions.

rules.name: Universal Master Footer Mandate
rules.description: Every page must include the exact master footer (.master-footer) with all 5 columns, official map embed, and ISO 9001 details.
rules.condition: Presence of class .master-footer with .footer-top-grid, .footer-map-card, and .footer-bottom.
rules.recommendation_template: Use only the standardized master footer component across all pages.
rules.validation: DOM query for footer.master-footer.

rules.name: Universal Card & Grid Integrity (Zero Squishing)
rules.description: Cards and grids must use minmax(0, 1fr) and width 100% to guarantee zero distortion or squishing across all viewports.
rules.condition: All grid children (.grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4, .reviews-grid) must have min-width: 0 and box-sizing: border-box.
rules.recommendation_template: Ensure all cards use universal responsive styling with minmax(0, 1fr) grid templates.
rules.validation: CSS rule inspection on grid and card selectors.

rules.name: 1-to-1 FAQ Accordion to JSON-LD Schema Parity
rules.description: Every FAQ question and answer displayed visually in HTML must be mirrored verbatim in the FAQPage JSON-LD structured data.
rules.condition: count(HTML FAQ items) == count(JSON-LD FAQPage Questions) with identical question/answer text.
rules.recommendation_template: Maintain exact 1-to-1 parity between visual FAQ items and JSON-LD FAQPage schema.
rules.validation: Extract DOM FAQ items and parse JSON-LD script, comparing strings verbatim.

rules.name: Robots Meta Directives & Snippet Controls
rules.description: All indexable pages must declare robots meta tag with index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large, and max-video-preview:-1 to enable full rich AI snippets.
rules.condition: meta[name=robots] present with index, follow, and max-snippet:-1.
rules.recommendation_template: Include <meta name='robots' content='index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-video-preview:-1'> in head.
rules.validation: Inspect meta name='robots' content string in DOM.

rules.name: Self-Referencing Canonical & Hreflang Tags
rules.description: Every page must have an absolute self-referencing rel='canonical' tag matching sitemap.xml, along with hreflang='en-IN' and hreflang='x-default' declarations.
rules.condition: link[rel=canonical] present and absolute; link[rel=alternate][hreflang] present for en-IN and x-default.
rules.recommendation_template: Add self-referencing canonical and hreflang alternate tags in head.
rules.validation: Extract canonical link and hreflang alternate tags from DOM head.

rules.name: Meta Title & Description Quality Standard
rules.description: Meta title must be 45-65 characters with primary keyword front-loaded. Meta description must be 130-165 characters with BLUF rate/policy figures and CTA.
rules.condition: 45 <= len(title) <= 65 and 130 <= len(description) <= 165 with zero keyword stuffing.
rules.recommendation_template: Optimize meta title and meta description length and front-load target intent keywords.
rules.validation: Measure character length of title and meta description tags.

rules.name: Image SEO: Explicit Dimensions, Alt & Lazy Loading
rules.description: All content images must have explicit width and height attributes to prevent CLS, descriptive contextual alt text, and loading='lazy' (except hero images).
rules.condition: All img tags contain width, height, and descriptive alt attributes.
rules.recommendation_template: Add width, height, and descriptive alt text to all image tags.
rules.validation: Inspect all img elements in DOM for width, height, and non-empty alt.

rules.name: OpenGraph & Social Meta Tags
rules.description: Pages must declare og:title, og:description, og:url, og:image, og:type, and twitter:card tags for consistent snippet rendering on social platforms.
rules.condition: Presence of meta property='og:title', 'og:description', 'og:image', 'og:url', and 'twitter:card'.
rules.recommendation_template: Provide complete OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata in head.
rules.validation: Inspect head for og:* and twitter:* meta tags.

rules.name: Contextual Internal Linking & Descriptive Anchors
rules.description: Internal links must use descriptive target keyword anchors (e.g. 'Jaipur Transport Services') rather than generic 'click here', 'read more', or 'link'.
rules.condition: Zero internal links with anchor text like 'click here', 'read more', or 'view more'.
rules.recommendation_template: Replace generic link anchors with descriptive service and location keywords.
rules.validation: Inspect text of all internal <a> tags for forbidden generic phrases.

rules.name: Breadcrumb Navigation & BreadcrumbList Schema
rules.description: Inner service and corridor pages must feature semantic breadcrumb navigation (.breadcrumb-nav) and valid Schema.org BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
rules.condition: Breadcrumb navigation present on inner pages with matching BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema.
rules.recommendation_template: Implement breadcrumbs with matching BreadcrumbList structured data.
rules.validation: DOM query for .breadcrumb-nav and JSON-LD BreadcrumbList entity.
